patterns.rhetorical_purpose: report a headline result while pre-empting the obvious follow-up question (why is a competing number higher?)
move_sequence: state the agent's result with its comparator baselines
explain the protocol difference that qualifies the comparison (1-shot demonstration vs. 0-shot)
note remaining headroom and future intent
patterns.reader_question_answered: Is 79.3% good, and why isn't it the highest number in the table?
patterns.transition_behavior: uses 'While ... Yang et al. (2024) provides ... whereas our evaluation ... is 0-shot' to name the exact confound rather than leaving the gap unexplained
patterns.evidence_placement: the qualifying detail (1-shot demonstration) sits in the same paragraph as the number it qualifies, not deferred to a separate limitations section
patterns.result_interpretation_pattern: number -> comparator -> protocol caveat -> forward-looking note, in one paragraph
patterns.limitation_framing: the caveat is attached to the specific claim it bounds, immediately, rather than listed generically later
patterns.signature: a result paragraph that names the strongest counter-example and explains the confound in the same breath
patterns.reader_effect: reduces the 'so why didn't you win' objection before the reader forms it
patterns.repair_principle: n/a (positive pattern to imitate, not an anti-pattern)

patterns.rhetorical_purpose: synthesize many individual benchmark rows into one cross-cutting claim
move_sequence: concede the paper does not top every category
name the one property held constant across categories (no prompt change)
state why that constancy is the significant part, by contrast with the baselines' typical specialization
patterns.reader_question_answered: With so many numbers, what is the one thing I should take away?
patterns.assumed_knowledge: none beyond having just read the category-by-category tables
patterns.transition_behavior: 'While ... may not achieve top performance ... Notably ... This is particularly significant when compared to ...' -- concession before claim, then the claim's warrant
patterns.evidence_placement: synthesis paragraph placed immediately after the three category tables it summarizes, before the per-category deep dives
patterns.result_interpretation_pattern: concession -> single unifying observation -> contrast with baselines' own scope
patterns.limitation_framing: the concession ('may not achieve top performance in every category') is stated up front rather than held back for a separate limitations section
patterns.contribution_framing: the cross-category constancy, not any single number, is framed as the noteworthy result
patterns.signature: concede-then-synthesize paragraph placed right after a block of tables
patterns.reader_effect: stops the reader from either over-crediting a single strong number or dismissing the whole section for not topping every table

note: Scoped down per state.json accepted_risk AR005: no web access means no full text of any exemplar paper other than project/paper.txt itself was available in this run, so patterns are drawn from paper.txt as a self-exemplar rather than from an external corpus of verified exemplar papers.
